posts.name: CoreSpeed
posts.tagline: One MCP for everything your agents need: apps, memory, tools
posts.description: CoreSpeed is an operating system for agents. Connect apps once and bring your accounts and shared or private memory to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP agents. Use multiple accounts per app, including X, with web search, social research and media generation built in. CoreSpeed holds app credentials. Budgets, activity logs and Smart Approval (beta) keep agents in check. Planned: Agent Drive, Mail, Pay, sandboxes, and more. Everything your agents need, through one MCP endpoint.

posts.name: Smooth Recorder
posts.tagline: Mac screen recordings that look edited when you hit stop
posts.description: Smooth Recorder is a native Mac app for demos and tutorials. It zooms in where you click, smooths your cursor, adds captions on your Mac and puts it all on a nice background. Screenshots get the same features.

posts.name: Gemini 4 Argon
posts.tagline: Google's frontier model for careful reasoning & complex work
posts.description: Gemini 4 Argon is Google’s frontier AI model for complex, long-horizon professional work. It combines advanced reasoning, coding, multimodal understanding, and cybersecurity-defense capabilities, with support for up to 1 million output tokens. Designed for software engineering, finance, legal work, and enterprise research, it helps solve multi-step problems while Google gradually expands access through trusted testing and safety safeguards.

posts.name: Blume 2.0
posts.tagline: The open-source docs framework for humans and agents
posts.description: Fast, AI-ready, and zero-config. Drop Markdown into a folder and ship a production-grade docs site with no app boilerplate to write or maintain. Free and open source, forever.

posts.name: ChatGPT Space
posts.tagline: Create, collaborate, and build together with AI in Space
posts.description: ChatGPT Space is a shared canvas for creating, planning, and collaborating with AI. Add links, files, and ideas to build a living source of context, then work with ChatGPT to turn them into plans, docs, apps, and more - keeping your team aligned in one place.

posts.name: opensend.cc
posts.tagline: The open source email platform that runs on your server
posts.description: opensend.cc is an open source email platform that runs on your server. It sends through your own AWS account, so your domain, your data and your sender reputation stay yours. You get a REST API and SDK, SMTP, templates, broadcasts, automations, audiences, webhooks and logs. One command installs it. No per-email pricing, no feature gates. Already on Resend? Change two lines and keep your code.

posts.name: WikiFix for Confluence
posts.tagline: Find and fix issues in your knowledge base
posts.description: WikiFix monitors your KB for issues like contradicting pages, duplicates and orphans, and fixes them in one click once you approve, so your team can trust what it reads or hears from AI.

posts.name: Thinking Orbs
posts.tagline: Animated AI Status Indicator Component Library for React
posts.description: A React component library of animated AI agent status orbs. Thinking, searching, compacting and more, built with attention to detail on every state and variant.

posts.name: Octri.dev
posts.tagline: Generate customizable Docs, SDKs, MCP server, and monitoring
posts.description: Upload an OpenAPI spec and Octri generates a fully customizable documentation site, high-quality client SDKs in ten languages (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Dart) and an MCP server so AI agents can call your API. The new part: every SDK reports its own production errors back, so you see integration failures before your users file tickets. GitHub sync regenerates everything on every merge.

posts.name: Pass Designer
posts.tagline: Design Apple Wallet passes and see the real card
posts.description: Whether you’re creating passes for a local fitness center, a small music venue, a global airline, or a national coffee chain, Pass Designer makes it easy to craft and preview passes that reflect your business.

posts.name: Capybara Court
posts.tagline: Tiny disputes, gently settled by a capybara judge
posts.description: Two people answer the same four questions about a small dispute. Each side is sealed; only Judge Cappy, a capybara, reads both. The ruling opens on both phones at once, fault never 100 to 0. Alone? Post to the gallery, names covered. It all shreds in 30 days.

posts.name: Rival Workshop
posts.tagline: A bookshelf app to manage every skill your agents read
posts.description: The Workshop app shows every skill in your repo as a book on a shelf: the spine is what Claude Code, Codex or Cursor reads before every task, and a bookend marks where each one stops. Switch skills off, make them run only when asked, rewrite them with Claude Code, and add good ones from the web after a safety check. One node command, and it runs on your computer. Includes 150 editable skills and Brief. One payment: $79 until Oct 31, 2026 (11:59 pm Pacific), then $149.

posts.name: DocsAlot MCP Connector
posts.tagline: Maintain your help-center by asking Claude, Cursor or Codex
posts.description: Create and update your knowledge base from Claude, Codex, or any compatible MCP client. Ask DocsAlot to add a page, fix an error, or improve your help center. It finds the relevant content, makes changes, creates a new version, and publishes, all from your existing workflow. See what questions users ask in your help center, discover what’s missing, and use those insights to improve your docs and decide what to build next.

posts.name: Calnio
posts.tagline: Two-way sync between Notion and Apple Calendar
posts.description: Calnio syncs Notion tasks and Apple Calendar both ways, real iCloud events with alerts, not a read-only webcal feed. Edit in either app, the other updates. Free, built by an indie dev and hosted on a Raspberry Pi at home.

posts.name: Sellio
posts.tagline: AI customer support in one shared inbox powered by AI agents
posts.description: AI customer support in one shared inbox: live chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, and email. AI agents trained on your docs, plus tickets and analytics.

posts.name: Angebotsmeister
posts.tagline: Speak the job to send a quote
posts.description: Angebotsmeister turns what a tradesperson says on site into a quote: proper line items, prices that show where they came from, a PDF the customer can accept online. One tap then makes the invoice. Built for the German trades, in German, free to start.

posts.name: Sente
posts.tagline: Talk to your coding agent
posts.description: A coding agent you can talk to — in your terminal or on your phone. 1. Voice, both ways. Read one sentence (~10 sec) to enroll your voice. Consent-first; the delete key is yours. 2. 404 models on one account — Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and more. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible. 3. MIT open source: github.com/yukihamada/sente Japan-built: Tokyo region, JPY billing. Honest limits: metered, not unlimited. Monthly credits; top up if you go over. We never clone a voice that isn't yours.

posts.name: TinyFolder
posts.tagline: App folders for your Mac Dock, designed your way
posts.description: The Mac Dock has no app folders, and since macOS Tahoe there's no Launchpad either. TinyFolder puts a folder of apps right in your Dock: one click opens it above the tile. Its icon is built from the apps inside, and you design the rest – glass, color or texture, layouts, icon size, labels, living effects like snow and lava – in a live preview. Free on the Mac App Store.

posts.name: Snapset
posts.tagline: Save and restore your entire Mac workspace in an instant
posts.description: Apps, window positions, browser tabs, even the folders you had open. A Mac menu bar app that remembers your entire workspace, and rearranges it automatically when you plug into a different display.

posts.name: Art4
posts.tagline: Small Art Museum for your Mac
posts.description: Do you like Monet’s gardens or Van Gogh’s skies? Art4 is a Mac app that turns your desktop into a tiny museum. Browse classic artworks, read short stories about each piece, and set your favorites as sharp, perfectly sized wallpapers—one-time purchase, no subscription.

posts.name: qarunbook
posts.tagline: A test plan your team and your AI can work through
posts.description: qarunbook helps you write a clear test plan, work through it yourself, with your team or with your AI over MCP, and keep track of what needs fixing or checking again. A fixed issue waits for a retest before it counts as passed. Free plan, no card.

posts.name: Cursor Remote Lite
posts.tagline: Use the Cursor on your computer from your phone
posts.description: Leave your laptop behind and keep working. Drive the real Cursor on your computer from your phone: answer the Agent's questions, approve commands, give it the next task (queued while it's busy), keep or undo changed files. Works in local, SSH remote and Agents windows; switch model and effort. Push notifications when the Agent waits on you. Code stays on your computer; the phone connects via a Cloudflare tunnel. Android app + iPhone. Free, MIT, self-hosted.

posts.name: Cupola
posts.tagline: Apple calendar, reminders & notes, together in one app
posts.description: One Mac app for your Apple Calendar, Apple Reminders and Apple Notes, with all three a hover away in your MacBook notch and as a standalone Mac app. Try it free for 7 days, then $20 once.

posts.name: Sorcrr
posts.tagline: Ai enabled bounty driven referral platform for hiring & gtm
posts.description: You hit pmf, pick up funding - now scaling fast... bottleneck - hiring. So you hire hr, and they tell you "its going to take 3 months!!!" This is where Sorcrr comes in. Sorcrr lets you create a video job description. Put a bounty on it. Share on your socials and have referrals come in. Need more speed up the bounty. Add your team, then vote, review, leverage ai assisted interviews, setup trials, send hiring offers, and you're done. One mobile first app with everything built in.

posts.name: Pixel Soup
posts.tagline: Dithered live wallpapers your Mac cooks up itself
posts.description: Pixel Soup makes your Mac's wallpaper for you. Pick a shape, a palette and a dither style, and it draws it live on your GPU, then keeps it gently moving behind your icons or freezes it as a still. Drop in a photo and it dithers that too. Hit one button for a random new wallpaper, or let it serve a fresh one every hour. No account, no tracking, no subscription. One payment and it is yours.

posts.name: LaunchReel
posts.tagline: claude design but for editing professional videos faster.
posts.description: LaunchReel is a Claude Code plugin that makes your videos: launch films and demos for your real product, written as code from your repo, and talking-head reels cut from your raw recordings. Claude does the work; LaunchReel adds a director's playbook, original music, voiceover and a studio to edit it yourself. Export 16:9 or 9:16, up to 4K.

posts.name: JOGAK
posts.tagline: Make everyday vlogs with less editing
posts.description: JOGAK is a vlog camera that joins the clips you record in shooting order. Capture everyday moments, review your timeline, adjust what you need, and save a finished video diary. Available for iPhone and Android. Free to download, with an ad option to export without the JOGAK logo.

posts.name: Blenny
posts.tagline: Organize your macOS 27 menu bar without moving your pointer
posts.description: Blenny is a free, open-source menu bar organizer for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 27. Keep essentials visible, reveal occasional apps with a click, and keep the rest hidden. Arrange apps in a draft, Apply when ready, and Undo the last change. No pointer movement, simulated clicks, or Screen Recording permission. Apache-2.0 licensed; self-signed, not Apple-notarized. The website has an interactive demo and the README lists compatibility limits.

posts.name: Poddle
posts.tagline: Swing your phone, play pickleball on any computer!
posts.description: Poddle is Wii Sports-style pickleball for your browser, played only with the devices you already own. Open poddleball.com on any computer, scan the QR code, and your phone becomes the paddle. On a Mac, one AirPod can be the paddle instead; a small open-source helper app streams its motion sensors to the game, and the other AirPod stays in the case. Play a friend online, take on Matt the bot at four difficulty levels, or run a tournament, and earn trophies as you go. 100% fun and free to play!

posts.name: Quven
posts.tagline: The self-hosted media server that puts native playback first
posts.description: A self-hosted media server for films, series and documentaries, with music and ebooks on desktop and web. Native apps for desktop, iPhone, iPad, Android, Android TV and Fire TV. Free for personal use, with hardware transcoding and no ads.

posts.name: Control My Mac
posts.tagline: A shortcut deck for every Mac app, on your iPhone or iPad
posts.description: Control My Mac turns your iPhone or iPad into a trackpad, keyboard and shortcut deck for your Mac, built so the whole Mac works with one finger. Its Grid of shortcut buttons switches automatically to match the Mac app in front. Write long messages on your phone and send them in one go. Launch apps and switch windows. Pair with one QR scan: no account, no servers, no ads, and an encrypted direct connection. The Mac app is free.

posts.name: Clair
posts.tagline: Answer Claude Code from your wrist
posts.description: Answer Claude Code's permission prompts, questions and plan reviews from your Wear OS watch or Android phone. Prompts travel end-to-end encrypted from your computer to your phone.

posts.name: Translate Like Me
posts.tagline: Translate selected text on Mac, in your own writing style
posts.description: A menu bar app for macOS. Select text in any app, press a shortcut, and it is replaced with the translation. The direction between your two languages is detected automatically, and each pair can have its own writing style. Runs on Claude, ChatGPT or Grok, through the subscription you already have or your own API key. Free and open source.

posts.name: Eat Train Feel
posts.tagline: A coach for you Workouts, food, and how you feel
posts.description: Build workouts from the equipment you own (AMRAP or rounds, a demo for every move), log food from 6,300 foods, track weight, sleep and HRV. A coach mode lets a personal trainer assign workouts and meal plans and see what was actually done. The Garmin app puts today's plan on your watch and saves it with a lap per exercise. Data is encrypted in your browser before it syncs. Free, no ads.

posts.name: FlexChords
posts.tagline: Turn any YouTube video into accurate, playable guitar chords
posts.description: FlexChords turns any YouTube video or audio file into accurate, synchronized guitar chords in seconds. Unlike tools with noisy predictions or paywalls, FlexChords pairs deep learning with music-theory smoothing to eliminate glitches and deliver clean, musical progressions. Features include YouTube & audio chord detection, synced playback & real-time chords, interactive timeline with chord editor, key & tempo estimation. Instant access to unlimited catalog songs + 5 free custom scans (per month).

posts.name: NotchMate
posts.tagline: Makes your Notch more fun, interactive and useful.
posts.description: NotchMate puts Notchy, a small furry monster, in your notch. It peeks, waves on unlock, wears glasses during focus, and goes quiet when you're busy. Open the notch for: -Music with album art and controls -Zen: synced karaoke lyrics or ambient visuals -Weather, calendar, Pomodoro -Clipboard history and file shelf -Window snap and camera mirror -Lid fold: the desktop folds as you close it Customize its color and fur. macOS 14+, works also without a notch, I added 9 languages.

posts.name: Aperture
posts.tagline: An AI code editor that checks its own work
posts.description: Open-source AI code editor. Composer plans a change and stages it as a diff. Before you apply it, every change is checked: it parses, imports resolve, types check, the preview renders, and tests run. Tests run in your browser tab, free.

posts.name: Chill Dash: Delivery Simulator
posts.tagline: A cozy delivery game. Explore, ride, and take it easy.
posts.description: Chill Dash is now live! I built this cozy 2D delivery game as a solo developer. Ride through charming towns, complete deliveries, upgrade your bikes, and explore at your own pace. From designing buildings and landmarks to building the gameplay, every part has been a learning experience. I'm excited to finally share it and hear what you think.

posts.name: Vibrant Design
posts.tagline: Design inspiration from the best of the internet
posts.description: Vibrant is a design inspiration website built around taste. It brings together standout websites so you can discover fresh ideas, explore different visual styles, and find references for your next project.

posts.name: MapNinja
posts.tagline: Find collectibles on game maps and track progress
posts.description: Search and filter interactive maps for Aion 2, Chrono Odyssey, Hogwarts Legacy, and Infinity Nikki. Find collectibles, secrets, bosses, and other locations, then mark what you've found to see your progress. Maps and tracking are free, with no account required. A free account syncs your progress across devices; Pro removes ads.

posts.name: Bid A Pixel
posts.tagline: Your logo. One pixel. Forever.
posts.description: What if you could own a tiny piece of the internet? Introducing BidAPixel. Claim a spot, add your logo, and join everyone else building a giant living mosaic of the internet. The more pixels get claimed, the stranger and more beautiful it becomes. Your logo. One pixel. Forever.

posts.name: MailVault
posts.tagline: Private email client that backs up every message you keep
posts.description: MailVault is a full email client with a vault behind it. Read, search and reply like in any client, while every message you keep is saved to your own disk as a plaineml file. Delete it from the server and your copy stays. Search 50,000 messages offline in under 15 ms. Clear the server without losing a thing. No account, no telemetry, passwords in your OS keychain, AI that can run on your own machine. Gmail, Microsoft 365, Outlook.com and any IMAP. macOS, Windows, Linux. Core is free.

posts.name: Interaktiv Tap
posts.tagline: Play Traktor's decks, FX and loops by hand on an iPad
posts.description: A multi-touch iPad instrument that plays Traktor Pro 3 or 4 over one USB cable, on a Mac or a Windows PC. Not a blank template to fill in: four decks, the mixer, four FX units and gesture loops are laid out for both hands, and the mapping talks both ways, so the iPad shows what Traktor is doing. Setup merges into your own Traktor settings and keeps your other controllers. Free to download, one-time unlock, no subscription.

posts.name: Vaniger
posts.tagline: Your AI tells you what to say when they pick up.
posts.description: Vaniger is an AI power dialer with a live AI teleprompter that tells you exactly what to say, in real time, on every call. Skip the sales trainingturn off your brain and just read the screen and close. No bloated subscriptions. Built for solo cold callers, SDRs, BDRs, sales reps, and teams of any size.

posts.name: Halvsy
posts.tagline: Scan the receipt, tap who had what, see who owes what
posts.description: Halvsy turns a photo of the bill into a group balance. It reads every line, tax and tip, and checks them against the printed total. You tap who had what, tax and tip are split in proportion to each person's order, and every share lands in the group. Friends join with a QR code, each group keeps its own currency, and settling up goes through whatever payment app you already use. No ads and no daily limit on expenses.

posts.name: MyCup.Me 2.0
posts.tagline: Professional Tournament Management Software
posts.description: MyCup is the all-in-one platform behind serious tournaments — multi-division structures, team panels, live standings, and a professional public website. Free to start.

posts.name: Reflex Game
posts.tagline: How fast is your brain, really?
posts.description: Play free online reflex games with zero input lag. Test your visual reaction time in milliseconds, F1 start speed, CPS click rate, and memory.

posts.name: Stresix
posts.tagline: Load test your app, get the server size it needs
posts.description: Point Stresix at a GitHub repo or Docker image. It runs your app on a fresh server, hits it with up to 10,000 users from a second one, measures CPU per core and memory, and tells you if your server is enough. No scripts. ~10 minutes. From $1.60 a run.

posts.name: GoEventBus — Intelligent Event Routing
posts.tagline: Go-native event bus with intelligent routing, powered by JEV
posts.description: GoEventBus is a high-performance event bus for Go with an optional intelligent routing layer. Handle events with deterministic rules first, reuse decisions through cache, and fall back to Jev only when input is ambiguous. Keep inference out of the hot path while execution stays fast and predictable in Go. Includes fan-out, ordered delivery, batching, backpressure, replay, Redis Streams, and RabbitMQ support.

posts.name: RemoTune
posts.tagline: Control music on your PC or Mac from your phone
posts.description: Control music on your PC or Mac from your phone. Play, pause, skip, and adjust your computer’s volume. Works with YouTube Music, Apple Music, and other media players. Connect in seconds over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, or by scanning a QR code. Free controls. No account needed.

posts.name: TachyRoute
posts.tagline: The Explainable, Multimodal, Early-Exit Decision Engine
posts.description: An open-source Non-Autoregressive Decision Engine. It evaluates typed decisions (choice, score, boolean) in <15ms using adaptive early-exit compute and attention rollout evidence extraction: without generating text, hallucinating or parsing fragile JSON.

posts.name: EliTrainer
posts.tagline: Fretboard trainer that listens to your real guitar.
posts.description: Free Windows fretboard + ear trainer that listens through your audio interface and grades the note your guitar actually plays, not a tap on a picture of a neck.

posts.name: Lovely
posts.tagline: 90+ free couple games to play online, no sign-up
posts.description: Lovely is a free collection of 90+ games for couples that run right in the browser. Would You Rather, Truth or Dare, This or That, deep questions, long distance games and a lot more. No account, no download: open it on date night or share the link over a video call. There's also a companion iOS and Android app with home screen widgets (countdown, shared drawing, distance between you) and a daily question you both answer.

posts.name: Cityscribe
posts.tagline: Save, organize, and share your favorite places
posts.description: Keep the places you love and the ones you want to visit on one unique map. Cityscribe lets you organize restaurants, hotels, and more into public or private lists, add notes and photos, and discover recommendations from friends. Plan your next trip or find your next favorite place. Free on iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: photoc
posts.tagline: Command-line tools for photographers
posts.description: Open-source CLI for JPEG workflows. Inspect EXIF, summarize shoots, find exact duplicates and potentially blurry shots, preview renames and sorting, and make contact sheets or compressed copies. Scrub GPS before sharing. Sony ARW metadata only; no HEIC.

posts.name: Siena - Networking Done For You
posts.tagline: Ask for connections, Siena will get straight to finding them
posts.description: Your Waivly Concierge 🌎 Looking for someone, something, or somewhere to start? Tell me what you need and I’ll see what I can find.

posts.name: Recora Screen
posts.tagline: The screen recorder you can edit with Claude or Codex
posts.description: Recora Screen is a free, open-source macOS recording studio that keeps capture and editing in one local workflow. Record your screen, camera, microphone and system audio on separate tracks. Turn clicks, drags and typing into editable zooms, trim timed text, images and blur on the timeline, transcribe locally with Whisper, and let Claude or Codex create projects, apply reviewable edits and export through MCP. Projects stay on your Mac; export up to 4K.

posts.name: My Halloween Link - Haunted House 2026
posts.tagline: Decorate a Halloween house, visit friends and collect candy
posts.description: My Halloween Link lets you design a Halloween house, share a simple public link, and let friends visit, knock, and collect candy from your bowl each house only once. Unlike typical decorating or social apps, visitors can open the house page on the web without needing the app. Core play (decorate, share, visit, collect) is free; optional one-time Pro adds a map, premium items & removes ads. A lightweight, link-first way to celebrate Halloween together.

posts.name: MCP LeadFlow
posts.tagline: Lead funnels built in under 60 seconds
posts.description: Build your lead funnels in under a minute. MCP LeadFunnel connects with Claude or your favorite LLM and takes your instructions or sample funnel screenshots and then builds the design, questions, disqualifiers, routing, paths, and api integration with your buyers. Lead funnels should be this easy to make.

posts.name: AdForge
posts.tagline: Turn proven Meta ads into video ads for your product
posts.description: Your best Meta ad dies in 10-14 days, and making the next one is the hard part. AdForge lets you pick a proven ad from the Meta and TikTok ad library, add your own product photos, screenshots or clips, and get a finished video ad that follows the same hook and pacing: script, AI voiceover, captions and music included. You see the credit cost before scenes render, failed shots are refunded, and there are no auto top-ups. Built for solo DTC founders who make their own ads.

posts.name: Instagram UGC Creator Finder
posts.tagline: Find and vet Instagram UGC creators, no signup
posts.description: Same finder, Instagram edition: search UGC creators by niche, follower band and country, preview public profiles, and run the vetting checklist before outreach. 24,000+ creators indexed, most of them nano and micro, which is the tier brands actually hire for UGC.

posts.name: Fennec - stop mac speaker crackling
posts.tagline: Watchfox for crackling mac audio
posts.description: Running too many tasks and your speakers are starting to crackle? Install Fennec to automatically detect and fix the crackling. This is a known problem on m1 mac (aka my my mac) so I made Fennec to automatically fix it for me. It's open source feel free to fork and remix. Fennec watches for audio failure signals on your Mac and offers a repair without needing terminal or a restart. Choose automatic repair with and it will detect the crackling and fix it for it. Apple silicon for macOS 14.2+.

posts.name: iTasks 2.0
posts.tagline: Team tasks, owners and deadlines — right inside Telegram
posts.description: iTasks is a powerful task tracker that lives inside Telegram — your team's tasks, owners, deadlines and discussions in the messenger you already use, right in your pocket. No install, no sign-up: invite teammates by link. Since our first launch: sprints and approval workflows, recurring tasks, voice AI, HelpDesk for your own bot, AI agents via MCP, an Android app and 11 languages. Free for teams of up to 3.

posts.name: Uprelic Strom
posts.tagline: Strom answers yes/no, multiple-choice and score questions.
posts.description: Strom answers yes/no, multiple-choice and score questions about text and images - it's inspired by Jev. It's fast, it's cheap, and every answer comes with a calibrated confidence. And it is hosted in the EU. 🇪🇺

posts.name: Recora Screen
posts.tagline: The screen recorder you can edit with Claude or Codex
posts.description: Recora Screen is a free, open-source macOS recording studio that keeps capture and editing in one local workflow. Record your screen, camera, microphone and system audio on separate tracks. Turn clicks, drags and typing into editable zooms, trim timed text, images and blur on the timeline, transcribe locally with Whisper, and let Claude or Codex create projects, apply reviewable edits and export through MCP. Projects stay on your Mac; export up to 4K.

posts.name: My Halloween Link - Haunted House 2026
posts.tagline: Decorate a Halloween house, visit friends and collect candy
posts.description: My Halloween Link lets you design a Halloween house, share a simple public link, and let friends visit, knock, and collect candy from your bowl each house only once. Unlike typical decorating or social apps, visitors can open the house page on the web without needing the app. Core play (decorate, share, visit, collect) is free; optional one-time Pro adds a map, premium items & removes ads. A lightweight, link-first way to celebrate Halloween together.

posts.name: Lofi Worlds
posts.tagline: Lofi music inside animated pixel-art space worlds
posts.description: Lofi Worlds plays dark, spacey lofi inside 42 animated worlds, from Saturn's rings to a black hole. Of those, 29 are pixel-art worlds drawn in code from real mission imagery, and 13 are painted windows seen from the same ship's cabin, with a cat on the sill. It runs in your browser with no ads and no sign-up. Mix in rain or a station hum, or let the guided tour fly you outward from the Sun. A $3 a month membership opens every painted window, and members can save favorites and build playlists.

posts.name: Artbucket
posts.tagline: One home for your brand. Shared by humans and AI agents.
posts.description: Keep brand assets, guidelines, and usage rights together. Share them with your team through portals and with AI tools through MCP. Publish your brand on BrandHub for others to discover. Open source and self-hostable, with managed hosting available.

posts.name: MCP LeadFlow
posts.tagline: Lead funnels built in under 60 seconds
posts.description: Build your lead funnels in under a minute. MCP LeadFunnel connects with Claude or your favorite LLM and takes your instructions or sample funnel screenshots and then builds the design, questions, disqualifiers, routing, paths, and api integration with your buyers. Lead funnels should be this easy to make.

posts.name: Cityscribe
posts.tagline: Save, organize, and share your favorite places
posts.description: Keep the places you love and the ones you want to visit on one unique map. Cityscribe lets you organize restaurants, hotels, and more into public or private lists, add notes and photos, and discover recommendations from friends. Plan your next trip or find your next favorite place. Free on iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: wallhop
posts.tagline: Read the article. Skip the wall.
posts.description: Paste a link, read the story. No signup, no extension. Tested on nearly every major outlet, local papers and Medium. Runs its own bypass methods; archive.is is only the last resort. Use the wallhop.io/ prefix, iPhone Share sheet, or API.

posts.name: SpeedTrackr
posts.tagline: Two-device practice sprint timing + session lab; web login.
posts.description: Practice-grade sprint timing for sprinters, coaches, and S&C athletes—without laser gates. Two start/finish devices; second Android, iPhone, or laptop. One elapsed time—no splits or multi-gate timing. Not FAT/federation timing. Android lab: start reaction, jump/RSI from flight-time video, and phone VBT. Coach Mode (roster + Excel) works on web and Android. Google Play: com.speedtrackr.reactionpro. Web: https://www.speedtrackr.com/auth/login. No native iOS app, form analysis, or Timing Pro.

posts.name: Final Wishes Vault
posts.tagline: End of life planner
posts.description: End of Life Planner turns a difficult, unfinished task into a guided afternoon: organize wishes, key papers, health notes, and digital-life instructions in five simple sections. Unlike basic templates or document vaults, it encrypts everything on your device, lets you control trusted access now or later with gentle check-ins, and exports a PDF plus encrypted offline pack your family can open without us.

posts.name: Parallax Cloud
posts.tagline: Push to GitHub and your site ships, with instant rollback
posts.description: Connect a GitHub repository and Parallax Cloud handles the rest: builds on every push, preview URLs for every branch and pull request, environment variables, live build logs, and custom domains with automatic SSL. Build output never changes, so promoting or rolling back a deployment just points production at something already built. Nothing rebuilds.

posts.name: YECI
posts.tagline: Give you a ready-made terminal workspace for vibe coding.
posts.description: A lightweight, reproducible development container for AI-assisted coding. Ships with the major AI coding agents alongside Swift, Objective-C, Go, Python, and Node.js runtimes, plus a complete terminal toolchain — every version pinned for reproducible builds.

posts.name: UNSPOKEN
posts.tagline: Prayer for real life
posts.description: UNSPOKEN is a prayer app for a real daily faith practice: prayer prompts, verses for hard days, and guided prayer.

posts.name: FreeCart
posts.tagline: Your cart has secrets.
posts.description: FreeCart finds the hidden free stuff and deals on Instacart so you can save money without digging through endless offers.

posts.name: Puffins
posts.tagline: look up any word anywhere in one place for language learners
posts.description: Puffins is a dictionary app for language learners, readers and translators. Look up any word in 20+ languages across 1000+ dictionaries (Wiktionary, Longman, Cambridge, Oxford and more) and switch sources with one tap. Add any dictionary site you like. When a definition isn't enough, ask AI Lookup for nuance and examples. Dictionaries and lookups are free, with no ads or tracking; only AI is paid. From the maker of Dictionariez. On Android now, iPhone in TestFlight beta.

posts.name: Whatsapp AI Agent SDK
posts.tagline: Build local-first WhatsApp AI agents under 1 minute
posts.description: Muse, Dot, Instinct- it feels like every week there's a new personal AI agent taking over the news. I built something that was on my list for a while, and finally open-sourced it: a WhatsApp AI agent SDK. Your model, your memory, your data all from your local machine; easy installation via npm. It also comes with a basic productivity agent out of the box(Gmail/Calendar; ask it anything in plain language). Install it and let me know what you think: github.com/csr1010/wappy-kit

posts.name: Desktop Destroyer
posts.tagline: Stress.exe for the browser. Free, no signup.
posts.description: Desktop Destroyer is a free browser toy for letting off steam. Smash, saw, burn and stamp a fake retro desktop with 9 weapons, then wipe it clean. No signup, no download, nothing saved. Built with vanilla JS, Canvas and Web Audio.

posts.name: HR360 by Omni Hire
posts.tagline: Hire smarter. Manage people better. Simplify HR.
posts.description: HR360 by OmniHire helps growing businesses streamline recruitment, resume tracking, employee onboarding, attendance, timesheets and HR operations in one platform. Simplify hiring and manage your workforce with less manual work.

posts.name: KittyHome Community
posts.tagline: Learn, chat and play with developers in a 3D cat world
posts.description: KittyHome Community is a free 3D world, right in your browser, where students and early-career developers explore as cats. Walk up to professionals (look for the green beams) and chat, or ask our AI mentor cats about frontend, backend, data, cloud or careers. Between questions, do daily duties, play arcade trivia, join treasure hunts and the Weekend Cup, and spend the coins you earn on hats and new characters, each with its own special move.

posts.name: Fermolog
posts.tagline: The brewing companion for home wine/mead makers and brewers
posts.description: Fermolog started as a simple batch tracker and is now a full brewing companion. New since our first launch: Ask Fermo, an AI assistant that reads your batch details, community sharing with an Explore feed, a cellar inventory, reusable recipes, and calculators for backsweetening, carbonation and TOSNA. Now with beer, cider and kombucha support, on iOS, Android and web.

posts.name: AlgoWay
posts.tagline: TradingView  Automation and  Telegram CopyTrade
posts.description: Connect TradingView alerts, Telegram signals, MT5, cTrader and custom webhooks to brokers, futures platforms and crypto exchanges from one execution layer. AlgoWay supports 22+ destinations with market, limit and stop orders, SL/TP, breakeven, partial closes, symbol mapping, multi-account routing and trade copying. Use it to automate existing strategies and signals without rebuilding them for every broker or exchange.

posts.name: B1 Sprechen
posts.tagline: Goethe & telc B1 speaking mock exam with AI examiners
posts.description: Practise the complete Goethe or telc B1 German speaking exam with AI examiners and an AI partner as the second candidate. Go through preparation and all three parts in exam order, then get feedback quoting your own sentences and replay your recording. One-time packs from €7.90; no subscription. No score, pass prediction or pronunciation assessment. Independent practice material; not affiliated with the Goethe-Institut or telc gGmbH.

posts.name: GTA Range
posts.tagline: Feel GTA-style guns on your PS5 DualSense, in the browser
posts.description: Plug a PS5 DualSense into desktop Chrome or Edge and fire 38 GTA-style weapons. Each one has its own adaptive-trigger feel, rumble kick, HD haptics and lightbar colour: melee winds up and snaps on R2, the Combat MG spins up, Molotovs set petrol trails alight. Or play GTA VI Trailer 2 and feel every shot, crash and engine through the controller. USB or Bluetooth, nothing to install. 5 weapons free, pay what you want to unlock the rest. Fan-made, not affiliated with Rockstar.

posts.name: Friday Work
posts.tagline: The multiplayer AI workspace for coding teams and agents
posts.description: Friday Work is a multiplayer AI workspace for teams and coding agents. Share a session and teammates join, watch and steer live. Pick up your existing Claude Code and Codex sessions with the same context, or run them beside Friday's agents, each in its own worktree, and hand work between them. Build saved agents with skills and triggers. Connect 50+ tools. Review the diff, commit, push and open the PR in one place. Mac and Windows, free to start; Pro and Max add frontier models.

posts.name: MailMyCertificate
posts.tagline: Certificates, without the busywork.
posts.description: Generate personalized certificates in bulk from a template and spreadsheet, then send them directly to recipients via Gmail. Save hours of manual work on every event, workshop, or course.

posts.name: ACE1600
posts.tagline: Digital SAT practice, mock tests, and live coaching
posts.description: ACE1600 turns digital SAT preparation into a clear routine: start with a free 49-question baseline and two free mocks, then learn, practice and review across Math and Reading & Writing. Paid plans add a 90-day daily program, 25 full-length fixed-form mocks, skill drills and saved review tools. Students can also choose individual or small-group live coaching. Independent SAT preparation; not affiliated with College Board.

posts.name: Gotcha RSS Feed
posts.tagline: A calm, native RSS reader for Mac, iPhone, and iPad
posts.description: Follow the sites you choose in a native RSS and Atom reader for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. No account, ads, tracking, or algorithm. Read cached articles, track unread stories, import your feeds, and open full articles when you need them. Built as a side project for a calmer daily reading habit.

posts.name: Layout
posts.tagline: Order food anywhere with AI
posts.description: Layout is the transactional infrastructure for AI food ordering. We're the platform-agnostic layer that lets any software place food orders for you end-to-end.

posts.name: Socialwealth ai
posts.tagline: Find out how much your sns values in market
posts.description: Zero clutter, instant valuation. Unlike bloated analytics platforms, this tool cuts through the noise to give you a clear, straightforward estimate of any YouTube channel's financial and brand value in just one click—completely free and without registration.

posts.name: OneBuckVideo
posts.tagline: Promote anything with a video, from $1. No subscription.
posts.description: Make a promo video for anything you want to promote: a product, app, event, service, course, place or idea. Paste a website or upload photos, and an AI storyboard writes the script, picks the animations and backgrounds, and adds a separate voice-over per slide. Edit any text, photo or timing, then pay from $1 per video. No subscription. Landscape and vertical formats. Try a free sample first.

posts.name: MailCripty
posts.tagline: Email cripted end2end
posts.description: MAILCRIPTY protects your messages with end-to-end encryption: the keys remain in your browser, and the server stores only unreadable blobs.

posts.name: Planli
posts.tagline: Super-Easy Booking Software for Beauty salons & Businesses.
posts.description: Planli is a simple online booking software for salons, barbers, nail artists, and appointment-based businesses. Manage services, staff, schedules, and bookings in one place. Give your customers an easy way to book online, without the back-and-forth.

posts.name: NailedIt.ai
posts.tagline: AI mock interviews for any job, spoken and scored
posts.description: Name the job or paste the posting. An AI interviewer asks questions out loud, listens, follows up on what you left out, and scores you on five skills: structure, judgment, specificity, relevance and communication. Practice the recruiter screen too: an AI recruiter asks your salary range, then what you make now. A second mode rehearses one-way recorded interviews against the clock. Two free scored mocks with a free account, no card. Then $29 a month (intro price through October 31; regular $49).

posts.name: NotePetal
posts.tagline: Turn notes into study pages, flashcards and printable PDFs
posts.description: Turn text, PDFs, Word documents and photos into editable study notebooks. Choose handwriting, paper, colors and layouts, including Cornell notes. Keep your wording or use AI to create study notes, check passages against their sources, practise with spaced-repetition flashcards, and export searchable PDFs. Try the preview without an account; a free plan is available.

posts.name: SEO AI Assistant
posts.tagline: Find and fix SEO, AEO & GEO issues in one click
posts.description: Most SEO tools only tell you what's wrong. SEO AI Assistant is a Chrome extension that audits any page for SEO, AEO and GEO, then fixes the issues for you. Get ready-to-use meta tags, FAQs and schema markup, so you rank on Google and get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews. No switching tabs, no spreadsheets, no guesswork. Just open a page, click, and fix. Built for founders, marketers and agencies who want results, not reports.

posts.name: Token Cut
posts.tagline: Cut LLM Token Costs With Jev Model Routing
posts.description: Route every prompt through TypeSafe Jev and send it to the cheapest model that can handle it. Cut LLM token costs and latency — wire it up in minutes. Token Cut helps developers cut AI costs by automatically routing every request to the lowest-cost model capable of handling it. Powered by Jev, it understands each task first, then selects the right model across providers like OpenRouter, fal.ai, Replicate, and Kie.ai. One API, smarter routing, less wasted spend — without sacrificing quality.

posts.name: Practivia
posts.tagline: Practice smarter. Grow faster.
posts.description: Practivia is an AI-powered learning and interview-preparation app that helps you practice technical questions, understand your weak areas, and improve through personalized practice. With Practivia, you can: • Practice technical questions across different topics • Get AI-generated questions and explanations • Generate questions from your resume • Practice based on a specific job description • Track your learning and practice progress • Identify areas where you need more practice.
